findings.title: Same-named but different operation classes exported from ./encryption and ./dynamodb
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The cited lines show same-named, different classes exported from ./encryption (Client-based) and ./dynamodb (EncryptionClient-based), a consumer-facing naming hazard created by this PR.

findings.title: Exported constructors and class identity become semver-bound public API
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The core claim holds (value exports expose constructors that take the internal Client; tsup builds separate entries with no splitting option); the CJS instanceof point is hedged as unverified but plausible.
